Subject: Quick follow-up + scheduling a 30m product tour

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier today. Quick recap from our side: Bluewave is evaluating inference platforms to reduce per-call latency for our clinical alerts pipeline and centralize model serving across environments (hosted for dev, private for PHI-sensitive inference). Tara (CTO) and Marcus (data platform lead) will want to see the runtime and Ops/observability features.

Can we book a 30-minute product tour/demo next week? Our target attendees: Tara (CTO), Marcus Lee (Data Platform), and myself. We're PST based. If you can share 2–3 options that work for your team, we’ll pick one and send calendar invites.

Also: are there any short pre-reads (1-pagers) you recommend we review beforehand? And we'll want to share a high-level procurement timeline during the meeting.

Thanks,
Sam
